Class InputHandler

java.lang.Object
splendor.display.InputHandler
public class InputHandler extends Object
Handles all user input prompts for the Splendor game.

    • promptTakeThreeGems

      public GemCollection promptTakeThreeGems(Scanner sc, GameState gameState, GameRules gameRules, DisplayUI display)
      Prompts the player to pick three different gem colors from the bank.
      Parameters:
      sc - the Scanner to read input from
      gameState - the current game state
      gameRules - the game rules for validation
      display - the display UI for rendering the gem bank
      Returns:
      a GemCollection of the three chosen gems, or null if the player backs out

    • promptNumPlayers

      public static int promptNumPlayers(Scanner sc, DisplayUI display)
      Prompts the user for the number of players (2-4) and returns it. Only used in local/offline mode.
      Parameters:
      sc - the Scanner to read input from
      display - the display UI for rendering the banner
      Returns:
      the number of players (2, 3, or 4)

    • promptPlayerType

      public static int promptPlayerType(Scanner sc, int playerNumber)
      Prompts the user to select a player type and returns it. Only used in local/offline mode.
      Parameters:
      sc - the Scanner to read input from
      playerNumber - the player number (1-based) being configured
      Returns:
      the player type (1=Human, 2=EasyBot, 3=HardBot)

    • promptPlayerName

      public static String promptPlayerName(Scanner sc, int playerNumber, String defaultName)
      Prompts the user to enter a player name and returns it. If the user enters nothing, the default name is returned. Only used in local/offline mode.
      Parameters:
      sc - the Scanner to read input from
      playerNumber - the player number (1-based) being configured
      defaultName - the default name if the user presses Enter
      Returns:
      the player name entered, or defaultName if blank

    • promptBirthDate

      Parameters:

      playerNumber - the player number (1-based) being configured
      Returns:
